text:
zoe: kicking off a tiny launch thread for the new OSS reference app + community tutorial series. goal: clear launch post, benchmark narrative that devs can trust, webinar, and inbound routing. doc: https://tiny.redwood/refkit-new (draft)

ana: love it. recommend emphasizing reproducibility: include the exact prompt sets and eval scripts so readers can run the same quality checks.

matt: benchmark narrative suggestion: three axes — latency, cost, and quality/regression vs baseline. call out sample prompts and failure modes.

jay: I'll add a runbook with 3 configs (local, cloud-staging, dedicated) + exact commands + sample CSV of convo traces. small code snippet for README:
```bash
./run_eval --model redwood-3b --prompts prompts.jsonl --out results.csv
```

marie: inbound routing: use utm_campaign=refkit_launch, utm_source=community, add hidden input capturing org size. route heavy leads to AE queue; add Segment->HubSpot mapping.

remi: webinar ops: propose 40m demo (live deploy of ref app) + 10m benchmark walk + 10m community Q&A. CTA: star GH repo + starter kit signup. need a 45m dry run 48h before.

zoe: messaging: two short hero lines to test on the blog modal: "Reference app: build LLM features faster" vs "Reproducible inference for production". small modal A/B.

ana: also add contributor docs + GH issue template for bugs/bench issues — want community to reproduce and fix regressions.

ops-bot: infra note: scheduled demo env build job queued (id demo-20260701-9). ETA ~3h.

matt: small PR checklist for the launch blog: TL;DR metrics, how-to snippet, bench CSV link, GH repo, webinar CTA, contributor guide link.

zoe: action items: matt write hero options (EOD), jay produce runbook + sample CSV (Fri), remi schedule dry run + slides (Wed), marie wire Segment->HubSpot routing (Thu), ana draft blog (Mon). I'll update the doc and ping this thread for quick reviews. :rocket:
